## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** characters op=live_use: resolve the slot, build a disc stacking the session's current mod + this slot, apply via session_swap (save, launch mod on the same PC, load, close old); KMDs reload only on a stage (re)start. Not yet seen on a screen.

**Pick whip: partial.** mgs_vr op=pick projects Snake and soldier actors through the view matrix (nearest within 12 px, letterbox handled), checked on 4 save states; characters op=resolve_slot names the slot for the desktop whip, then live_use rebuild + session_swap. Ninja/other figures not pickable.

**Live controls:** mgs_vr tool: status, complete (the manager's own clear routine, 3 writes read back), unlock_all (fills the result routine's BSS grid, nops its StoreImage), pick, stages; live_controls NATIVE allows complete and unlock_all. No live receipt of the writes found.
